item.voyagercloakdsc: A battery-fed cloaking rig. Common amongst Voyagers.

other.gamesetgunsaw_abilitykeybinddsc: The universal key used to activate species abilities.
other.gamesetgunsaw_diettooltipsdsc: Shows a colored tag in the extended item description indicating whether a food is preferred for your current species. Off by default. This is mainly meant to help new players learn GG's diet system.
other.gamesetgunsaw_disabledietsdsc: Disables all species dietary restrictions and their penalties. Species-specific food bonuses (like Leapy's foliage tolerance) are unaffected.
other.gamesetgunsaw_disableexpmodifiersdsc: Disables all per-species experience rate changes. Every species gains STR/RES/INT at the normal rate, and the modifier display is hidden.
other.gamesetgunsaw_disablesettingssearchdsc: Hides the settings search bar entirely, in case it causes visual issues with other mods. Requires a restart to take effect.
other.gamesetgunsaw_disabletailspritesdsc: Hides species tail sprites in WoundView. Enabled by default.
other.gamesetgunsaw_languagedsc: Language file to use for Gunsaw Genetics' own dialogue/text.
other.gamesetgunsaw_mercenary_levitationdsc: Key used to grab objects with Mercenary's Levitation chip.
other.gamesetgunsaw_mercenary_reformationdsc: Key used to Reform during Mercenary's death sequence.
other.gamesetgunsaw_spriteslot_downdsc: Switches to the previous available sprite slot.
other.gamesetgunsaw_spriteslot_updsc: Switches to the next available sprite slot.
